---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_games
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Flag shortened seasons (WWI, work stoppages, and COVID-19)
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
      "Shortened season",
      "Full season"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Full season" = "#2b5c8f", "Shortened season" = "#d95f02")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MLB Home Run Rate Over Time",
    subtitle = "Shortened seasons sit right on trend once measured as home runs per team-game",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Team-Game",
    color = "Season Type",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_team_games
  )
```
